purpose: Discovery references selected by each private profile; no sources enabled by default.

sources.name: Freelancer.com
sources.authentication: Public basic search succeeded without credentials; the official SDK documents OAuth 2.0 for general API access.

evidence.observation: JSON status success; one returned project and total_count 16. The worker also observed full description, skills and budget fields on an expanded request; owner_id was null and users empty.

sources.freshness: Keep time_submitted and time_updated separate; ordering by time_updated does not prove a newly published project.

polling.note: No universal quota verified. Respect current response limits and back off on HTTP 429; any future schedule must be configured separately.

sources.storage: API terms limit storage and require cached data to be refreshed at least every 24 hours; do not assume an unrestricted archive.
limitations: Anonymous employer identity, reputation and country details were not established.
API reachability does not verify proposal eligibility or current account access.

sources.name: Freelancehunt
sources.authentication: Account-generated Bearer token from Apps and API settings.

evidence.observation: The docs distinguish the open-project list /v2/projects from the employer's own /v2/my/projects. No authenticated call was made.

filters.validation: Documented behavior only. Resolve actual skill IDs and validate filtering with the authorized token; use local text matching.

polling.note: No current guaranteed numeric quota established; do not treat an old example as a quota.

limitations: Some Plus-only details are restricted.
No public-project webhook or incremental changed-since filter was confirmed.
Country and payment eligibility were not checked.

sources.name: Upwork
sources.authentication: Approved application credentials, OAuth 2.0 and the granted marketplace-read scope.

evidence.observation: Marketplace search and RECENCY sorting are documented. No approved-account request was made.

other_requirements: Approved description of the intended use
eligibility.usage: Personal/internal only; commercial use is not supported by the current application guidance.

polling.note: Support says 10 requests/second/IP, while indexed GraphQL docs say 300/minute/IP. Confirm the granted limit and explicitly describe scheduled personal monitoring in the application.

storage.note: Do not assume derived data or IDs may be retained indefinitely.

limitations: Account eligibility and approval are unknown.
No unrestricted global new-project webhook was verified.
RSS support ended after 2024-08-20.

sources.name: FL.ru
sources.authentication: None required in the observed feed requests.

evidence.observation: Both feeds returned RSS with 60 items; the category feed identified Programming. Item count is a snapshot, not a documented limit.

limitations: Regional optional source; Candidate country account/payment eligibility was not checked.
A functioning RSS feed does not verify every posting or its proposal route.

sources.name: Codeur.com
sources.authentication: None required in the observed feed requests.

evidence.observation: First-party RSS returned 35 items; the filtered channel title was Angular. No formal public API documentation or RSS link in the current listing HTML was found.

limitations: Live first-party RSS, not a documented REST API contract.
French-language source; do not infer French proficiency from private candidate evidence.
Candidate country account/payment eligibility was not checked.

sources.name: Himalayas
sources.authentication: Public access without a key; optional free Bearer key for a separate account allowance.

evidence.observation: JSON jobs returned. This was not an exhaustive filter or coverage test.

freshness.cache_note: A rarely requested query can return an older copy while it refreshes.
freshness.json_pubDate_semantics: Last updated, not original publication, according to the current JSON API reference.

polling.note: Respect shared public limits or the optional key's documented account allowance. Cached data means repeated calls need not expose newly posted jobs.

limitations: Check employmentType, locationRestrictions and timezoneRestrictions.
Use applicationLink and visible Himalayas source credit; preserve applicable API terms.

sources.name: Remote OK
sources.authentication: No authentication required by the official public-feed guidance.

evidence.observation: JSON array contained 98 job records after excluding metadata. This is a snapshot, not a guaranteed feed limit.

polling.note: No current numeric polling guarantee established.

limitations: Skip legal/metadata objects rather than treating every array element as a job.
Filter contract type, stack and location locally; retain original job links and credit.

sources.name: We Work Remotely
sources.authentication: Public RSS; no authentication required in the observed request.

evidence.observation: RSS parsed successfully. Contract and location eligibility still require checking.

polling.note: No current numeric polling guarantee established.

limitations: RSS is the verified discovery interface; the separate partner posting API is not a search API.
Keep source attribution and links; deduplicate overlapping category feeds.

sources.name: Jobicy
sources.authentication: No key required for public listing URLs; paid/direct-ATS-link access is a separate optional service.

evidence.observation: JSON jobs returned. Current website documents up to 100 per page, whereas the GitHub README advertised 200; use the website's conservative limit and validate.

polling.scope: Start of a new synchronization pass; continue cursor pages sequentially within a pass.
polling.note: A few passes per day are normally enough; obey Retry-After and avoid scheduling on minute 00.

limitations: Absence from the seven-day feed does not establish closure.
Credit Jobicy and preserve its listing links for public API data.
Discover current industry/location slugs rather than inventing them.

sources.name: Remotive
sources.authentication: Public API; no credentials used in the successful parent requests.

evidence.observation: Returned 15 jobs across mixed categories despite category/limit parameters. The response warning concerned the old domain migration, not an announced result cap. A worker request separately received HTTP 403.

polling.note: Provider recommends no more than four daily requests. Do not use for immediate project alerts.

limitations: Validate filters and coverage; match locally, and do not claim the observed 15 rows are a documented permanent cap.
Credit and link back to Remotive; redistribution and signup-gated listing restrictions apply.

sources.name: PeoplePerHour
sources.authentication: Account saved searches; separately authorized mailbox access would be needed for ingestion.

evidence.observation: Up to 10 saved searches with instant or daily new-result emails. No public project-search API was confirmed.

limitations: No alert was configured and no mailbox was accessed.
Email ingestion would not be a PeoplePerHour project API.

sources.name: Workana
sources.authentication: Account project-notification settings; separately authorized mailbox access would be needed for ingestion.

evidence.observation: Official help describes project email notifications. No public project-search API was confirmed.

limitations: No alert was configured and no mailbox was accessed.

sources.name: Freelancermap
sources.authentication: Account project alerts; Basic one alert and Premium unlimited per current help.

evidence.observation: Advertised https://www.freelancermap.com/feeds/projects/int-international.xml returned HTTP 404. Official help documents project email alerts.

limitations: Do not configure the unavailable RSS endpoint as an active source.
Advertised XML/JSON interface imports employer projects; it is not confirmed discovery/export.
No alert, subscription or mailbox ingestion was set up.
Remote labels do not establish worldwide eligibility; inspect required language, presence and country restrictions.
The cited listing is activity evidence, not a verified application recommendation.
No public discovery API or global new-project webhook was verified.

follow_up_evidence.observation: A public C#/.NET, Angular, Azure and IoT listing was published on 24 November 2026. Official help documents project alerts. The application route and eligibility to perform that engagement from Israel were not verified.

runtime_check.note: No new provider API/feed request, account login, alert setup or subscription action was performed; the earlier HTTP 404 observation is preserved.

sources.name: XPlace
sources.authentication: Use the established project-search workflow and current account terms.

evidence.observation: Retained as the existing local project source. This addition did not establish a public API or RSS feed.

limitations: Do not infer an API from listings mentioning API development.
Search access does not authorize paid proposal access.

sources.name: Fiverr

evidence.observation: Official MCP searches freelancers, seller services and reviews. It does not document a stream of new client projects for freelancers to pursue.

limitations: Do not claim Fiverr has no official API/integration.
Do not configure supplier search as new-project discovery.

sources.name: Guru

evidence.observation: The official help-linked API documentation returned HTTP 403; public project-search capability was not established.

limitations: A 403 does not prove that no API exists.
Do not configure an unverified historic RSS/API URL as a working monitor.

sources.name: Malt

evidence.observation: Official API/token material exists for other operations, including invoices; public opportunity search was not confirmed.

limitations: API existence alone does not establish public project discovery.
No public job-post stream or global new-project webhook was verified.
Language, client location and business verification can limit matches.
Use the fee shown in the current quote, including country-specific exceptions.
Profile counts and reviews do not prove current openings or that every client originated on Malt.
sources.authentication: Freelancer account and business-identity verification. Israel is listed as an allowed registration country for eligible registered businesses; the user's account and payment setup were not tested.

follow_up_evidence.observation: Official guidance documents direct client matching and no public job postings. Israel is listed as an open registration country. A public .NET/Angular technical-lead profile has a September 2026 client review; this is activity evidence, not a vacancy or matching guarantee.

runtime_check.note: No new provider API/feed request, account login, identity verification or matching access was tested; earlier evidence is preserved.

sources.name: Lemon.io
sources.authentication: Developer application and screening; matching depends on acceptance and current client demand.

evidence.observation: The .NET developer page describes curated matching and includes .NET/Angular examples updated in July 2026. Those examples were not verified as currently open projects.

runtime_check.note: No provider API/feed request, account login or matching access was tested.

limitations: No public project-discovery API, RSS feed or global new-project webhook was verified.
Israel-specific intake, screening acceptance and client requirements remain unverified.
Published examples are activity evidence, not verified application routes.

sources.name: Proxify
sources.authentication: Developer application and screening before access to matched client engagements.

evidence.observation: Official pages describe long-term developer engagements and a .NET route. The CET +/-3-hour window fits Israel's time zone but does not establish country eligibility.

runtime_check.note: No provider API/feed request, account login or matching access was tested.

limitations: No public project-discovery API, RSS feed or global new-project webhook was verified.
Israel intake and current matching availability remain unverified.
A recruitment page is not a verified client project; check actual Angular work, location and mandatory qualifications for each match.

sources.name: YunoJuno
sources.authentication: Approved contractor account required for the personal profile-matched RSS URL; no account-specific URL was obtained.

evidence.observation: Official help documents RSS for matching new job posts after contractor approval. Contractor access is described as free and supports global contractors; Israel-specific onboarding was not verified.

runtime_check.note: No account approval, personal feed retrieval, RSS request or subscription setup was performed.

limitations: The RSS address is account-specific; no generic endpoint is supplied.
A profile-matched feed does not establish coverage of all opportunities.
Israel-specific account and payment eligibility remain unverified.
No numeric polling allowance or global new-project webhook was verified.

sources.name: Toptal
sources.authentication: Talent application and screening; project access depends on acceptance and matching.

evidence.observation: Official material describes curated freelance matching. TopAccess has separate annual subscription terms; applicability to a particular applicant or access route was not established.

runtime_check.note: No application, account login, provider API/feed request or subscription action was performed.

limitations: No public project-discovery API, RSS feed or global new-project webhook was verified.
Screening acceptance, Israel-specific access and current .NET/Angular matches remain unverified.
Distinguish Core network participation from TopAccess; do not present the paid subscription as a universal charge for every route.

sources.name: Contra
sources.authentication: Account job-feed and matching-email features. The separate MCP needs account authorization; opportunity-discovery access through MCP was not established.

evidence.observation: Help documents job-feed skill, tool and budget filters and match-triggered emails. MCP documentation covers talent search, hiring and account workflows, without establishing freelancer-side new-opportunity search.

runtime_check.note: No account login, notification setup, MCP connection or provider API/feed request was performed.

limitations: No public machine-readable discovery endpoint, polling allowance or global new-project webhook was verified.
Matching emails do not establish complete coverage.
Verified paid portfolio work does not prove the client originated through Contra.
Israel-specific payout setup remains unverified; consult current transaction, payout and currency-conversion fees.

sources.name: Braintrust
sources.authentication: Account saved-search settings; separately authorized mailbox access would be needed for ingestion.

evidence.observation: Official help documents saved-search email alerts and lists Israel among supported payment destinations. This does not establish eligibility for every advertised role.

runtime_check.note: No account login, saved search, mailbox access, payout setup or provider API/feed request was performed.

limitations: No public project-discovery API, RSS feed or global new-project webhook was verified.
Filter each opportunity for contract type, actual .NET and Angular work, country, hours and mandatory qualifications.
Payment-country support does not override client location restrictions.
